title: Gold & Silver Jewellery Mandatory Hallmarking Regulations & 3X Consumer Compensation
qco_name: Hallmarking of Gold Jewellery and Gold Artefacts Order
source_authority: Bureau of Indian Standards / Department of Consumer Affairs

clauses.title: Mandatory 3-Part Hallmark Signs and 6-Digit HUID
clauses.text: Regulation 6: All gold jewellery sold in hallmarked districts must bear exactly 3 indelible marks: 1. The BIS Logo (triangular mark), 2. Purity in Karat and Fineness (24K999, 22K916, 20K833, 18K750, 14K585), and 3. A 6-character alphanumeric Unique Identification Number (HUID). Sale of hallmarked jewellery without HUID is illegal.

clauses.title: 3X Consumer Compensation for Substandard Purity Gold
clauses.text: Regulation 12: If any hallmarked jewellery purchased by a consumer is tested at a BIS-recognized Assaying and Hallmarking Centre (AHC) or Referral Lab and found to have less purity than marked, the registered jeweller shall compensate the consumer with 3 times (3X) the difference in the price of the shortage in purity, along with reimbursement of testing charges.
